title: Add Built‑in Request Body Validation Middleware
description: Integrates a lightweight schema‑based validator into the request pipeline, allowing developers to declare JSON schemas for route payloads. This prevents malformed data from reaching handlers, reduces boilerplate, and improves security and reliability.
testCases: Valid JSON payload passes through and reaches the route handler
Invalid JSON payload returns 400 with detailed error message
Missing required field triggers validation error
Extra unknown fields are ignored or flagged based on schema options
acceptance: When a route registers a validation schema, the middleware validates incoming JSON bodies, returning a 400 response with a clear error object for any schema violations, while allowing valid requests to proceed unchanged. All tests pass and existing routes remain unaffected.
reason: Ensures data integrity at the edge of the application, reducing runtime errors and defensive code in handlers, which aligns with the framework’s stability focus and offers high‑impact value to users.
